_comment: Raw activity names, exactly as the game spells them, mapped to canonical metric IDs.
Deliberately tiny. The generic parsers already produce a predictable ID for almost every
activity, so an entry earns its place only when the derived ID would be wrong or useless,
and only when the raw form can be justified from a real message. Keys are matched
case-insensitively against the activity captured by the parser, before the ID is built.
Adding an entry changes what a board admin must type, so treat it as a contract change.

count._comment_lunar: Message: 'Your Lunar Chest count is: 30.' The parser keeps 'Chest' as part of the proper name, which is right, but older wording drops it and yields the meaningless 'kc.lunar'.
count._comment_barrows: RuneLite's ChatCommandsPlugin renames 'Barrows chest' internally, confirming the bare form occurs.
count._comment_slayer: Message: "You've completed 250 tasks...". The captured name is the bare word, which would slug to the meaningless 'kc.tasks'. The Wilderness and Mortimer variants are named so a board can ask for one of them specifically.

duration._comment_gauntlet: The Gauntlet's counter says 'Gauntlet' while its loot and timer messages say 'The Gauntlet'. One activity, so one metric ID.
